evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To broaden the evaluation scope, we introduce three novel benchmarks--authority bias (fabricated citations), confidence bias (assertive phrasing), and formatting bias (structured presentation)--and evaluate across seven bias types in total.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across three frontier models, self-debiasing improves performance in 20 out of 21 model-bias combinations with gains up to 15 percentage points, while bias-aware prompting also yields consistent improvements.
